name: BBirthday
source:
Help Bianca to relive the 15 years of her life, but from another perspective 👁️. Enjoy this dreamcore style visual novel with escape room elements and hints of horror.

[From [url=https://yun-seven.itch.io/bbirthday]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
帮助比安卡从截然不同的视角👁️重温她十五年来的人生岁月吧。尽情体验这部融合密室逃脱要素与淡淡恐怖气息的梦核风格视觉小说。

[摘自[url=https://yun-seven.itch.io/bbirthday]itch.io[/url]]
